modules.name: Module 03 — Customer Authentication & Account Access (phone + OTP, frontend-first)

Web + Android in parallel on Mock* repositories behind ProfileRepository / FavoriteRepository / AddressRepository / PaymentMethodRepository / NotificationRepository. Backend, Razorpay tokenisation, FCM/SMS/email providers, change-phone OTP, email verification and account deletion backend are registered as carry-forward and NOT STARTED.
